title: 第23章 劝说江云风第24章 初战告捷
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
“现在说，是没有说服力的，我喜欢用事实说话，我能不能夺得第一，等会儿看着就是了。”
江尘道。
“好，那么爷爷就要看看，你是如何夺得第一的，哈哈。”
江天笑着离开了。
从江尘的身上，他看到了年少轻狂。
江天走了之后，江云风对江尘道：“尘儿，你怎么承诺说弥补四万灵石呢？我一时之间，可无法筹到这么多灵石。”
江云风面露难色。
他也责怪江尘太冲动了，如此大事，居然不跟他商量一下，就夸下海口了。
到时候如果还不上四万灵石，那么可会成为笑柄的。
到时候江海更有理由嘲笑于他了。
“爹，放心吧，这四万灵石，我来出，你不用担心。”
江尘道。
“什么？四万灵石可不是一笔小数目，你来出？你从哪里来的这么多灵石？”
江云风吃了一惊。
前段时间江尘还问他要灵石与资源呢。
怎么，一段时间不见，这个江尘就如此财大气粗了。
不得不说，江尘这段时间确实有点古怪，实力暴涨就不说了，还说能拿出四万灵石，这个江尘是不是有什么事瞒着他？
而且，还跟火老打好关系，请动火老出手救自己。
江云风觉得自己快看不透江尘了。
江尘苏醒了之后，他就觉得江尘的变化很大，变得更加自信了。

同时，也变得更加天才了。
江尘武者境十重的修为，江云风也是知道的，当时江云风也是大吃一惊。
怎么在这么短时间内，实力暴涨这么多？
江尘说他是得到机缘了，至于具体是什么机缘，江尘没有明说。
每个人都有自己的秘密，而且江尘又是自己的儿子，江云风当然为江尘高兴，没有追问下去。
“爹，你放心就是，这件事不用担心了，对了，爷爷准备选出下一任族长，爹，我希望你也参与竞争。”
江尘道。
“啊？我也要参与吗？但是，我不太想当族长。”
江云风道。
他不喜欢那种争权夺利的事情。
觉得有伤兄弟之间的感情，当一个长老就挺好的。
“爹，你不当族长的话，如果让大长老当成族长，肯定会为难你的，只要你当了族长了，有爷爷的支持，对方也翻不出什么浪。”
content_en:
"It's not convincing to say it now. I like to speak with facts. Whether I can win the first place will be decided later."
Jiang Chen said.
"Okay, then grandpa will see how you won the first place, haha."
Jiang Tian smiled and left.
From Jiang Chen, he saw youth and frivolity.
After Jiang Tian left, Jiang Yunfeng said to Jiang Chen: "Chen'er, how can you promise to make up for 40,000 spirit stones? I can't raise so many spirit stones in a short time."
Jiang Yunfeng looked troubled.
He also blamed Jiang Chen for being too impulsive. He boasted about such a big thing without discussing it with him.
If it doesn't reach 40,000 spirit stones by then, it will become a laughing stock.
By then Jiang Hai would have even more reason to laugh at him.
"Dad, don't worry, I'll come up with these 40,000 spirit stones, you don't have to worry."
Jiang Chen said.
"What? Forty thousand spiritual stones is not a small amount of money. You come to pay for it? Where did you get so many spiritual stones?"
Jiang Yunfeng was surprised.
Some time ago, Jiang Chen asked him for spiritual stones and resources.
Why, I haven’t seen him for a while, and this Jiang Chen is so wealthy.
I have to say that Jiang Chen is indeed a bit weird during this period. Not to mention his sudden increase in strength, he also said that he can produce 40,000 spirit stones. Is there something Jiang Chen is hiding from him?
Moreover, he also established a good relationship with Mr. Huo and asked Mr. Huo to save him.
Jiang Yunfeng felt that he could no longer see through Jiang Chen.
After Jiang Chen woke up, he felt that Jiang Chen had changed a lot and became more confident.
At the same time, he also became more talented.
Jiang Yunfeng also knew about Jiang Chen's cultivation at the tenth level of the warrior realm. Jiang Yunfeng was also shocked at that time.
Why did his strength increase so much in such a short period of time?
Jiang Chen said that he had gotten an opportunity. As for the specific opportunity, Jiang Chen did not say clearly.
Everyone has their own secrets, and Jiang Chen is his own son. Of course Jiang Yunfeng was happy for Jiang Chen and did not ask further.
"Dad, don't worry, you don't have to worry about this matter. By the way, grandpa is planning to elect the next clan leader. Dad, I hope you will also participate in the competition."
Jiang Chen said.
"Ah? Do I want to participate too? But, I don't really want to be the clan leader."
Jiang Yunfeng said.
He doesn't like that kind of struggle for power.
I feel like it hurts the relationship between brothers. It's good to be an elder.
"Dad, if you are not the clan leader, if you let the great elder become the clan leader, it will definitely make things difficult for you. As long as you become the clan leader and have grandpa's support, the other party will not be able to make any trouble."
